title: Homogeneous evaluation lifts span the associated graded quotients locally
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ a morphism and $x:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$ a finite generating family for $I$. Put $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] and $B_k=J^k/J^{k+1}$, with projection $\pi_k$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces]. Suppose functions $l_{k,U}:A[T_0,\ldots,T_{r-1}]_k\to J^k(U)$ are given on every open, whose structure-sheaf image is evaluation in the images of the generators, using the coefficient map $\rho_U=f^\sharp|_U$. Then for every $k$, every open $U$, every finite family $a:\operatorname{Fin}(s)\to B_k(U)$, and every point $y\in U$, there is an open $y\in W\subseteq U$ such that each $a_i|_W$ lies in the $\mathcal O_X(W)$-span of the sections $\pi_k(l_{k,W}(b))$ for homogeneous $b$ over $A$. No graded multiplication or unit hypothesis is required. Empty generating and section families are allowed.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 0884 (lemma-vanishing-projective), first paragraph; finite polynomial cover refinement of the associated graded ideal algebra. Supporting affine calculations: Schemes 01I8 and 01IC, as recorded by lem-weil-pbc-ideal-times-quasi-coherent-affine-sections.

proof.text: Reuse formalPolynomial_power_injective from FormalPolynomialPowerLifts, specialized to J.toModulesι, rather than reproving monicity or sectionwise injectivity. Reuse formalPolynomial_extendedIdeal_affine from that same module for the affine generator calculation. Prove the purely algebraic span assertion. For a ring map rho:A→R, an element v in the kth power of the ideal spanned by rho(x_i) is the evaluation of a homogeneous polynomial p over R by Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous. Expand p by MvPolynomial.as_sum. For every supported exponent d, homogeneity gives d.degree=k, since otherwise hp.coeff_eq_zero contradicts support membership. The monomial with exponent d and coefficient one is homogeneous over A. Its rho-evaluation multiplied by coeff d p equals the evaluation of the corresponding term of p. Submodule.sum_mem and Submodule.smul_mem place v in the span of homogeneous evaluations over A.

Choose an affine neighbourhood W of y inside U using X.isBasis_affineOpens. The kth power module M is quasi-coherent: the structure module in degree zero, and the positive-power clause of ideal_times_quasiCoherent_affine_sections otherwise. Apply the affine quotient-surjectivity clause to M to lift each a_i restricted to W through pi_k. The power-range clause places each lift image in J(W)^k; at degree zero this follows from J(W)^0=top. The affine ideal-extension calculation identifies the generators, as in ideal_comap_appLE and ideal_top_ofIdealTop.

Let S be the section-ring span of the given l(k,W,b) in M(W). Submodule.map_span and the stipulated image formula identify the image of S under the power inclusion with the span of homogeneous evaluations. The algebraic span assertion puts the lift image in that submodule. Extract a preimage in S; sectionwise injectivity of the power inclusion shows it equals the quotient lift. Finally apply the linear quotient map and Submodule.map_span again to obtain membership in the span of projected lifts. The affine W works for all sections of the finite family, including an empty family.

proof_origin.place: Complete Lean proof of the affine power refinement of Stacks Tags 0884 and 087Z, using Schemes Tags 01I8 and 01IC; elementary gluing and monomial details written by G2.

theorem formalPolynomial_quotient_span
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    {r : ℕ} (generators : Fin r → A)
    (hgenerators : Ideal.span (Set.range generators) = I)
    (l : ∀ (k : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A k →
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f).toModulesι k).1.val.obj
          (op U))
    (hl : ∀ k U b, (Scheme.idealSheafPower _ k).2.val.app (op U) (l k U b) =
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
          (((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom).comp
            (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom))
          (fun i => (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom
            (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom (generators i))) b.val) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (s : ℕ)
      (a : Fin s → (formalAssociatedGradedPiece ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) k).val.obj (op U))
      (y : X), y ∈ U → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), y ∈ W ∧
        ∀ i, (formalAssociatedGradedPiece _ k).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (a i) ∈
          Submodule.span Γ(X, W)
            (Set.range (fun b => (formalAssociatedGradedπ _ k).val.app (op W) (l k W b)))
